name: publication_playlists
description: Each playlist copied into a publication, with the branch that owned it when it was published, so a restore can check the program's current reach.
lifecycle: Inserted with its publication; never updated. Deleted with its publication.

columns.Meaning: Company that owns the publication; immutable (tenant key).
Copied playlist; not a foreign key, so the copy outlives the playlist.
Branch that owned the playlist when it was published.
columns.Null meaning: The playlist belonged to the whole company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, branch_id) REFERENCES branches(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The owning branch belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, publication_id) REFERENCES publications(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.Purpose: The publication belongs to the same company; rows go with it.
One row per playlist and publication.
